text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're definitely going to
the next Japan Cup, right!?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious?! I mean, Rudolph and Brian are going head-to-head, for real?!

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text: Huh!? No interview this week!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry!
We have received an especially large number of interview requests this week...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, many people are trespassing.
Due to dealing with everything, it's become harder than usual to get interview permissions.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text: Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, which one's gonna win?
President Rudolph after all?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I wonder?
I mean, don't you kinda want to see it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: The moment the "greatest in history" is rewritten!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you that curious
about the outcome of this match?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna climb even higher.
The next time I race you... I won't lose."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then, "when the time comes."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ……It is already "that time", then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(—On the day of the race, it'll surely be a full gate.
Multiple contenders other than just myself.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (She's in there.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone is loading into the gates.
Me, her, and——)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Phaaah!
Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...The same result again, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training for the Japan Cup,
Narita Brian suddenly came to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen was strong.
And so were Mihono Bourbon and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Still, Symboli Rudolf is even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Is that not so?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I was able to compete against rivals of peerless strength in both the Tenno Sho (Spring) and Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's exactly why I understand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just how extraordinary that girl sitting
on the throne of the "Emperor" truly was.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I might end up repeating that same result again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...With every race I run,
the contours become ever clearer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The wall of the "Emperor" is thick and formidable.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps trying to surpass it is reckless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she speaks, Narita Brian's legs
are trembling ever so slightly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haha...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What if it wasn't?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What if I was actually... truly frightened?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an expression I had never seen on her face before.
...Narita Brian was nervous.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: And what if you lose?
choice_data_list: If it's Narita Brian, she won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ......*Sigh*. Good grief—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (Come to think of it, the origin of this habit was—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. In a race, the one who crosses the finish line
first is the winner, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Don't make me repeat myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haha... Are you stupid?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ever since then, you've been—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing. Even if I told you,
you wouldn't remember anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ......What a huge fool.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day, a press conference was scheduled to be held ahead of the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: First to appear at the venue was Symboli Rudolf, and as for Narita Brian—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Hey, has Brian not shown up?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Are you thinking of scratching from the race?
But that's...

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
No, that might actually be possible.
I heard she challenged Rudolf to a mock race before
and lost...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SLIDE!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...You're late.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, I forgot something.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I forgot to give you my declaration of victory this time.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me!
Brian-san, what did you just say...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I will surpass the "Emperor." Without fail, in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: W-What a bold statement...! Is she not even considering the possibility of losing...!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: Special feature, special feature! Hurry!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...There's no turning back now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I had no intention of backing down from the start.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian stepped up alongside Symboli Rudolf
and extended her hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—Just a little longer until their showdown begins."
